lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - A Look and learn

details: Look and learn highlights and makes explicit the grammatical structure want + infinitive that students have been using, covering meaning form & pronunciation.
Look for understanding and address any questions or misconceptions.
“I’m thinking about making a wish list today… all the things I really want to try or be. When I look at these children, I wonder what their big wishes are. What do you think they want most?

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - B Read and write

details: Read and write asks students to fill in the gaps to check their production of the  ‘want + infinitive’ structure.
Look for confident use of the structure want + infinitive and correct use of the first and third person present tense forms of want.
“When I read about other kids, I feel like everyone has a special wish. Some want fun, some want food, some want adventures… everyone’s list is different. What’s on your wish list?”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.22 - C Look and write

details: Look and write requires students to select the correct words to fill the gap and add the word ‘to’, checking their understanding of the grammar structure.
Look for correct placement of the word ‘to’.
